dedupe_keys.name: data for an open modeling framework to support the electrification of private transport in african cities a case study of addis ababa

description: Jérémy Dumoulin publishes the code and data accompanying an EVPV-simulator application to private-vehicle electrification in Addis Ababa. Zenodo serves an open ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost; internal file formats were not listed on the deposit page. The related publication models 100,000 electric vehicles and estimates roughly 350 MWh of daily charging demand. It reports that home, workplace and public charging locations change demand timing and charger needs, while photovoltaic production can supply part of the load. This is a reusable city-planning example for electricity-grid stress and charging-capacity simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Addis Ababa application. A limitation is that the figures are modelled estimates for a data-scarce city, not measured EV adoption or an approved charging plan. The archive was not downloaded, and the simulation inputs, outputs and numeric results were not independently reproduced.
